name: Matjaž Nemec-§ 30-Am 25
title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2026
part_text: 30. Reiterates its opposition to the existence of the EEAS, given that the Member States already have embassies in the various countries; furthermore, firmly opposes the opening of European Parliament offices in Moldova and the Western Balkans, countries that are not Member States; considers those initiatives to be disconnected from the real priorities and expectations of Union citizens regarding the sound management of public finances;
